title: Emrys and the Archive
author: Wren Thornbury
blurb: Xanthe Nakamura, a clone who inherited the original's murder case, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the jump window closes.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
